name: Beijing Originwater Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Originwater Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the water treatment business in China and internationally. The company offers sewage treatment technical solutions. It also provides recycling with membrane technology, such as scheme and engineering design, electronic control and system integration technology, system installation and engineering technology commissioning, technical support, and managed operation services; and solid waste treatment, atmospheric environment treatment, ecological engineering, and restoration technology related services.
